channel.description: Latest articles from MediaToday Co Ltd (maltatoday.com.mt)

item.title: Man avoids jail as court suspends sentence in Qormi burglary appeal
item.description: The appellate court replaced a three-year prison term with a suspended sentence after accepting that the man’s role in the burglary was driven by drug addiction and noting his successful completion of a rehabilitation programme

item.title: PN claims government introduced ‘hidden’ tax increases over Christmas period
item.description: PN accuses government of quietly raising fees across the financial services sector through legal notices issued after the budget

item.title: Momentum opposes proposed high-rise development at Marsalforn hotel site
item.description: The political party has warned that a planned 12-storey project on the Calypso Hotel site would further damage Gozo’s skyline

item.title: Man receives suspended sentence for domestic violence against mother, brother
item.description: 24-year-old man handed a two-year suspended prison sentence after pleading guilty to multiple domestic violence offences against his mother and brother

item.title: Property prices rise by 5.7% in third quarter of 2025, NSO says
item.description: The Residential Property Price Index continued to climb both annually and quarterly, with apartment and maisonette prices also registering steady increases

item.title: Man receives suspended sentence for threats and harassment
item.description: Man sentenced to one year in prison, suspended for two years, after pleading guilty to threatening and harassing a local man

item.title: Omissions, whataboutism, and reputation laundering of a registered sex offender
item.description: With a thick folder full of case documents in front of him, Justin Haber claimed that the case against him was a frame-up, while Ricky Caruana questioned none of the claims • Haber and Caruana bond over fact that young girls appear older than they are

item.title: Court acquits man of illegal cannabis cultivation charges
item.description: The magistrate noted shortcomings in how the evidence was documented and safeguarded

item.title: Malta Womens Lobby condemns reputation laundering of convicted sex offenders
item.description: The Malta Women's Lobby says that attempts to improve the public image of individuals who have been found guilty by the courts do not promote justice or healing, and may instead minimise the experience of abuse survivors

item.title: WATCH | Edward Zammit Lewis wants more Labour MPs to criticise the government
item.description: Xtra on TVM | ‘We’re not parrots’: The MP and former minister says criticism is healthy as long as it comes with good intentions
